name: sessions
description: Browse every Claude Code session across all projects; archive them to another folder, move old ones off this Mac, restore them.

archiveDir.title: Archive folder
archiveDir.description: Folder the mod copies ~/.claude/projects into (same layout), e.g. /Volumes/MyDrive/claude-sessions/projects. Empty: no archive.

autoArchive.title: Archive automatically
autoArchive.description: Copy new and changed sessions to the archive folder when a session starts and every 6 hours.
